## Steering Committee

The Steering Committee consists of representatives of previous, current and future hosts of the Data Donation Symposium, together with the early-career representatives. See [About](about.qmd#how-the-network-is-organised) for how it works.

The [2027 symposium](symposium/2027/index.qmd) in Budapest is organised by the Centre for Social Sciences of Eötvös Loránd University. Committee members will be announced.
